title: Astra · controls study v2 pair 2 · shortcuts · 1–128

action.intent: Inspect fortress status, population, and provisions before establishing production and shelter.
Return to the map and open workshop construction to establish a carpenter's workshop.
Select carpenter's workshop for placement.
Leave workshop placement and open tree-cutting designations to obtain building material.
Exit building placement and open tree-cutting designations.
Designate nearby trees for cutting, then let woodcutters produce workshop materials.
Open carpenter workshop placement now that felled logs are visible.
Place the carpenter's workshop on clear ground near the wagon and felled logs.
Confirm willow log for carpenter construction, return to play, and allow construction time.
Select and inspect the carpenter's workshop in building-query mode before queuing furniture.
Queue five beds at the completed, selected carpenter's workshop and allow production time.
Leave building query and unpause so the carpenter can make the five queued beds.
Inspect the carpenter's workshop to verify bed production and remaining jobs.
Queue five barrels for brewing and food storage at the selected carpenter's workshop.
Prepare a still near the carpenter to establish drink production.
Confirm the still location and inspect available construction materials.
Select a willow log to commission the still.
Let dwarves work on the newly commissioned still and queued furniture, then inspect progress.
Inspect the still and verify that construction is complete before queuing brewing.
Queue plant brewing at the confirmed completed still, then assign a brewer.
Open the citizen list to choose a dwarf for brewing and farming labors.
Select idle jeweler Lokum and open preferences and labor settings to assign food production.
Return from Lokum's profile to inspect available unit controls.
Locate Lokum on the map to access native labor preferences.
Open Lokum's labor preferences to assign brewing and farming.
Open Lokum's farming labors to assign brewing and food production.
Disable Lokum's accidental mining assignment and open Farming/Related using menu navigation.
Enable farming, brewing, and plant gathering for Lokum.
Leave the labor submenu after verifying farming, brewing, and plant gathering are enabled.
Open downward-stair designation to begin excavating shelter beneath the surface.
Designate the entrance stair and matching upstairs one level below.
Excavate a first underground room adjoining the stair and allow queued work to progress.
Open farm-plot placement in the excavated soil room.
Position a 3×3 farm plot on the excavated underground soil.
Place the valid 3×3 underground farm plot and allow construction and workshop jobs to progress.
Inspect the underground farm plot and its crop settings.
Select plump helmets and assign them to all seasons.
Let dwarves plant the configured plump-helmet farm and complete beds and barrels.
Place the first bed along the underground room’s southern wall.
Place the first available bed at (16,21) underground and allow construction.
Inspect the first bed to verify construction and prepare a shared dormitory.
Allow workers time to haul and install the bed and finish barrel production.
Inspect the installed bed and its room options.
Define a shared sleeping room from the completed bed.
Confirm bedroom area and enable communal dormitory use.
Place another bed beside the confirmed dormitory bed.
Confirm the second bed's material selection.
Place the remaining three available beds beside the dormitory bed.
Select the surface carpenter’s workshop and inspect its remaining barrel jobs.
Queue two additional beds at the selected carpenter's workshop.
Select the completed still to restart brewing as barrels become available.
Queue brewing at the selected completed still, using newly produced barrels.
Let dwarves brew drinks, make barrels and beds, and tend the farm.
Select the carpenter's workshop and inspect its remaining jobs before ordering dining furniture.
Queue three dining tables at the selected carpenter's workshop.
Queue three chairs at the selected carpenter and allow furniture production and brewing to progress.
Leave workshop query and resume simulation so queued furniture and brewing jobs can proceed.
Inspect the carpenter's remaining jobs after production time.
Select the still and inspect brewing progress.
Repeat the selected brewing job and resume work to sustain drink production.
Inspect fortress status and food and drink supplies after brewing.
Return to the fortress view to inspect construction and expand the living area; brewing has increased drink stocks to about 90.
Inspect the selected workshop and its remaining jobs.
Inspect the carpenter's remaining jobs before adding production.
Open building query to verify the carpenter selection and current queue.
Select the carpenter's workshop and inspect its remaining jobs.
Move the building-query cursor toward the carpenter and verify selection.
Move the query cursor onto the carpenter's workshop and inspect its queue.
Queue two more beds at the selected carpenter's workshop, then allow production to progress.
Leave workshop query and resume simulation so queued furniture and brewing jobs can progress.
Gather surface plants to replenish brewing ingredients and food.
Inspect the underground farm and dormitory to verify food production and bed construction.
Inspect the underground farm and its planting status.
Move the query cursor onto the underground farm to inspect its crop settings.
Confirm plump helmets for every season and place another dormitory bed.
Place the sixth dormitory bed and allow farming, gathering, and construction to progress.
Place the seventh bed beside the six completed dormitory beds.
Confirm the seventh bed and allow construction, gathering, and farming to progress.
Inspect the underground room for possible flooding; water glyphs now cover the farm and beds.
Inspect the surface for a dry replacement dormitory and farming site after confirming water in the underground room.
Select the surface carpenter’s workshop to prepare replacement beds for a dry dormitory.
Move the query cursor onto the carpenter's workshop and verify selection before ordering replacement beds.
Queue five replacement beds at the selected carpenter's workshop and allow production and gathering to progress.
Leave workshop query and resume simulation so the queued furniture jobs can progress.
Open bed placement to check replacement beds and establish dry sleeping space on the surface.
Inspect the carpenter's workshop to find why replacement beds are unavailable.
Inspect the active carpenter job to diagnose the delayed replacement beds.
Let the active carpentry job and plant gathering progress, then inspect the fortress.
Inspect the underground level before designating a dry replacement farm north of the flooded rooms.
Designate a separate entrance north of the flooded rooms for a dry farm and shelter.
Designate the matching upward stair beneath the new entrance and inspect the underground terrain.
Excavate a dry room beside the new staircase, away from the flooded southern rooms.
Open farm-plot placement to establish renewable food and brewing crops in the newly excavated room.
Place a small farm plot in the dry excavated soil room.
Inspect the newly placed farm plot and its construction status.
Allow the farmer to construct the selected farm plot.
Inspect the farm plot’s construction status and crop options.
Select plump helmets and assign them to all seasons on the completed farm plot.
Place the first bed in the underground shelter, south of the farm.
Select a willow bed for installation and allow construction and farming to proceed.
Inspect the placed bed and begin defining a shared sleeping room.
Expand the bedroom boundary and confirm it, then inspect dormitory options.
Enable the communal dormitory and inspect placement of another bed.
Confirm the second bed location and inspect available beds.
Select a bed for construction and let dwarves build and farm.
Inspect the first bed to verify the shared dormitory is active.
Place another bed in the confirmed communal dormitory.
Select a bed for the third dormitory sleeping spot and allow construction and farming to progress.
Inspect current food and drink reserves before expanding production.
Begin placing a food stockpile near the underground farm and dormitory.
Create an underground food stockpile beside the farm and allow hauling and farming to proceed.
Open table placement to furnish an underground dining area.
Place a dining table at 17,17 and inspect the material selection.
Confirm the table material, then place a chair beside it.
Confirm the willow chair and allow furniture construction and farming to progress.
Select the completed table and inspect dining-room creation.
Define a small dining room around the completed table.
Enable the dining room as a meeting hall and let farming, hauling, and construction progress.
Inspect the farm's planting status and seasonal crop settings.
Let farming, hauling, and furniture production proceed.
Select the surface still to inspect brewing readiness.
Move the query cursor onto the completed still and inspect its job queue.
Queue brewing at the selected completed still to replenish drink supplies.
Repeat the selected brewing job and let dwarves work on farming, brewing, and hauling.
Inspect the still's brewing queue and repeat status.
Inspect the carpenter's queue before adding barrels for food and brewing storage.
Queue five wooden barrels at the selected, completed carpenter's workshop to support brewing and food storage.
Resume the fortress so dwarves can make the five verified queued barrels and continue farming and brewing.
